input.title: Women's Tennis – Tennis Club (Mostly Social) Crewneck Sweatshirt
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

Two laughing women in white tennis dresses share a courtside bench and tall lemonades while their rackets lean unused behind them, and the sweatshirt says TENNIS CLUB (mostly social). This tennis sweatshirt is for the league friend who signs up for the lunch, not the match.

The print shows two 1960s women in headbands and tennis dresses laughing over iced lemonades on a wooden bench, two wooden rackets leaning against it and a green ball rolling away on the court. TENNIS CLUB is in navy slab capitals above and (mostly social) in red script below.

Wear it to league day, the clubhouse terrace or a cold-morning warm-up, and give it to the friend whose doubles team is really a brunch group. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

What is the Tennis Club (Mostly Social) sweatshirt?
It is a crewneck sweatshirt from Graphic Tees Co. printed with two friends and their lemonades beside unused rackets, lettered TENNIS CLUB (mostly social). It is a Gildan 18000 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece, with no hood and no pockets, so it layers over a tennis dress or a tee.

How does the crewneck sweatshirt fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. crewneck is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a roomier layer over a tee. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How warm is it and how do I wash it?
The sweatshirt is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, a solid layer for a cool terrace or a courtside bench. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. That keeps the navy and red inks from fading and the fleece soft after many washes.

Is it a good tennis gift for a friend?
Yes. It suits the league friend, the doubles partner or the mom who plays for the social part. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $34.99, comes in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give for a birthday, a season-end party or Christmas.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. tennis sweatshirt should arrive before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
